name: Ancient Thebes with its Necropolis
description: Thebes, beside the Nile at modern Luxor in Egypt, was the capital of the pharaohs during the Middle and New Kingdoms and the city of the god Amon. On the east bank, the vast temple complexes of Karnak and Luxor still stand. Across the river, the Valley of the Kings and Valley of the Queens hold the rock-cut tombs of rulers and their families.
